method: Built-in image_gen edits of client-supplied images
purpose: English localized website illustrations. Chinese originals are preserved. Unreadable certificate fine print uses neutral rules; not substitute legal documents.

prompts.showroom: Edit target: supplied showroom photograph. Create an English-language localized version of this exact photograph. Preserve composition, aspect ratio, people, furniture, cat logo, architecture and lighting. Replace main gold 3D Chinese sign CBD·健康家居 with exactly 'CBD · WELLNESS HOME' in matching gold dimensional lettering with same perspective. Translate distant Chinese wall copy into small English 'WELLNESS FOR EVERYDAY LIVING' and product plinth Chinese into 'CBD'. No Chinese characters anywhere. Do not invent additional claims. Output only the edited photograph.
prompts.factory: Edit target: supplied panoramic factory photograph. Create English localized version of this exact panorama. Preserve original very wide 3:1 aspect ratio and framing, buildings, skyline, mountains, dusk light, all composition. Replace building sign 'CBD 健康家居' with exactly 'CBD WELLNESS HOME', retaining red CBD and white WELLNESS HOME dimensional illuminated letters on same facade perspective. Other signs if legible must be English, no Chinese. Do not add buildings, logos, overlays or claims. Output only edited panorama.
prompts.awards: Edit target: supplied square photograph of awards and framed recognition documents. Create English-language localization preserving same frames, trophies, arrangement, material, light and colors. All visible Chinese text must be replaced by English. Top headings use 'AWARD CERTIFICATE', 'CERTIFICATE OF HONOR', and 'CERTIFICATE OF RECOGNITION'. Translate clear award labels as 'HOME FURNISHING BRAND OF THE YEAR', 'INNOVATION AWARD', 'BRAND INFLUENCE AWARD', 'OUTSTANDING CONTRIBUTION AWARD', 'PERSON OF THE YEAR', 'CHINA BRAND DAY'. Retain CBD and already-English ISO/numbers only where originally present. For tiny unreadable paragraphs use sparse fine horizontal decorative rules, not invented recipient names, numbers, claims or issuing bodies. Remove Chinese lettering inside small seals rather than inventing signatures or new validation marks. This is a localized website illustration, not a replacement legal document. No Chinese or non-Latin pseudo text anywhere. Output only photograph, no external caption.
prompts.certification: Edit target: supplied wide photograph of trophy and patent/certification frames. Create an English-only localized website visual with EXACT same arrangement, warm wood background, trophy and framing. Replace big left headline 专利与体系认证 with 'PATENTS & CERTIFICATIONS' split into two elegant white lines. Top three frames headline 'DESIGN PATENT CERTIFICATE'. Bottom green frame headline 'PRODUCT QUALITY CERTIFICATION'. Bottom blue frame headline 'OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY MANAGEMENT'. Preserve existing ISO 9001 and ISO 45001 lettering. Replace all other Chinese including seals with English typography or fine neutral horizontal rules where original text is too small or illegible; do not invent patent IDs, signatures, recipient names, dates, verification codes, issuers or new endorsements. No Chinese characters or gibberish. Preserve existing visual composition and 1.8:1 aspect. This is a translated website illustration, not a replacement legal certificate. Output only localized image.

awardsRevision: Edit ONLY two lettering areas in this supplied English awards photograph. Keep every other pixel/composition/frame/trophy/material unchanged. 1. On the ORANGE RED transparent upright trophy near bottom center, remove ALL remaining tiny white Chinese-like lettering at its very bottom and replace with just the clear English 'CHINA BRAND DAY' on a single small line. No Chinese or pseudo glyphs. 2. On the dark BLUE trophy immediately to its right, change 'PERSON OF THE YEAR' to exactly 'OUTSTANDING CONTRIBUTION AWARD' in three balanced lines; leave its CBD above unchanged. This corrects the translated award title. Preserve square aspect ratio. Output only the corrected photograph.
